dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Your organization at a glance: which agents are working now, how tasks are progressing, and how much you are spending.

buttons.0: New Task: create work for an agent
buttons.1: Charts: activity of the last 14 days
buttons.2: Recent tasks: open one to see its conversation

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.description: Everything that needs a human: agent questions, failed runs and work ready for review.

buttons.0: Open an item to reply or approve
buttons.1: Mark as read to clear it
buttons.2: Filters: show only what matters now

issues.title: Tasks
issues.description: Each task has one owner (agent or person), a status and a conversation. Example: “Draft the patient consent form for the new laser treatment”.

buttons.0: New Task: describe the work and choose who does it
buttons.1: Status: backlog → to do → in progress → review → done
buttons.2: Group / Sort / Columns: change how the list looks

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Group related tasks under one health program, e.g. “Diabetes education campaign” or “Clinic website”.

buttons.0: New Project: create a program with a lead agent
buttons.1: Open a project to see its tasks and progress
buttons.2: Star a project to pin it in the menu

routines.title: Routines
routines.description: Work that repeats automatically on a schedule, e.g. a weekly report of appointments or a monthly compliance review.

buttons.0: New Routine: choose the agent, the instructions and the schedule
buttons.1: Pause / Resume: stop or restart a routine
buttons.2: Run now: execute it once immediately

artifacts.title: Artifacts
artifacts.description: Documents, images and files produced by agents. Review them before using them with patients.

buttons.0: Open a file to preview it
buttons.1: Comment on a passage to request changes
buttons.2: Download to use it outside the app

agents.title: Agents
agents.description: Your AI team. Each agent has a role (e.g. Medical Director, Patient Coordinator), a model (Claude, Gemini, GPT…) and a budget.

buttons.0: New Agent: hire a new team member
buttons.1: Pause / Resume: stop an agent at any time
buttons.2: Open an agent to edit instructions, skills and runs

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: Reusable know-how for agents: clinical protocols, writing guides, privacy rules. Install health skills from the catalog.

buttons.0: Install: add a skill from the catalog
buttons.1: Studio: write or edit your own skill
buttons.2: Assign: give a skill to specific agents

apps.title: Connectors
apps.description: Connect external services so agents can use them. Each action can be Allowed, Ask first or Off.

buttons.1: Permissions: choose what agents may do
buttons.2: Disconnect: remove access at any time

activity.title: Activity
activity.description: Audit trail: every change, who made it and when. Useful for clinical governance and compliance.

buttons.0: Filter by agent, person or type
buttons.1: Open an entry to see the details
buttons.2: Export when an auditor asks for it

org.title: Org chart
org.description: Who reports to whom. The lead agent delegates work down the chart.

buttons.1: Click an agent to open it

costs.title: Costs
costs.description: Money spent by each agent and budgets. When a budget limit is reached, the agent pauses automatically.

buttons.1: Budgets: set monthly limits per agent or project

goals.title: Goals
goals.description: High-level objectives, e.g. “Reduce no-shows by 20%”. Tasks and projects link to a goal so agents know why.

buttons.1: Link projects and tasks to a goal

company_settings.title: Settings
company_settings.description: Organization details, members, secrets (API keys) and advanced options.

buttons.0: Type a word and press Enter
buttons.1: Open a result to go to it
Write your message and press Send

ui.healthNotice: Health data: agents must not receive identifiable patient data unless your setup complies with your local law (e.g. LOPDP Ecuador, HIPAA, GDPR).
